    29	/**
    30	 * @file
    31	 *   This file implements the command line parser.
    32	 */
    33	
    34	#include "parse_cmdline.hpp"
    35	
    36	#include "common/code_utils.hpp"
    37	
    38	namespace ot {
    39	namespace Utils {
    40	
    41	static bool IsSpaceOrNewLine(char aChar)
    42	{
    43	    return (aChar == ' ') || (aChar == '\t') || (aChar == '\r') || (aChar == '\n');
    44	}
    45	
    46	otError CmdLineParser::ParseCmd(char *aString, uint8_t &aArgc, char *aArgv[], uint8_t aArgcMax)
    47	{
    48	    otError error = OT_ERROR_NONE;
    49	    char *  cmd;
    50	
    51	    aArgc = 0;
    52	
    53	    for (cmd = aString; IsSpaceOrNewLine(*cmd) && *cmd; cmd++)
    54	        ;
    55	
    56	    if (*cmd)
    57	    {
    58	        aArgv[aArgc++] = cmd++; // the first argument
    59	    }
    60	
    61	    for (; *cmd; cmd++)
    62	    {
    63	        if (IsSpaceOrNewLine(*cmd))
    64	        {
    65	            *cmd = '\0';
    66	        }
    67	        else if (*(cmd - 1) == '\0')
    68	        {
    69	            VerifyOrExit(aArgc < aArgcMax, error = OT_ERROR_INVALID_ARGS);
    70	            aArgv[aArgc++] = cmd;
    71	        }
    72	    }
    73	
    74	exit:
    75	    return error;
    76	}
    77	
    78	} // namespace Utils
    79	} // namespace ot
